name: Introduction
summary: Docs introduction to Animate UI: an open distribution of animated React components, primitives and icons for the shadcn registry.
description: Animate UI is a copy-first distribution of React components built with Tailwind CSS and Motion on the shadcn registry model: animated primitives authored in-house or ported from Radix UI, Base UI and Headless UI, essential components with minimal shadcn-style baseline styles, and animated Lucide icons. Source is copied into your codebase instead of installed as a wrapper library, and the baseline styles stay easy to restyle.
contains: animated primitives ported from Radix UI, Base UI and Headless UI
components with minimal baseline styles inspired by shadcn/ui
copy, modify and customize the source directly in your codebase
built with Tailwind CSS and Motion
